title: The graph factory: what it builds on, and how it says it
note: What the graph factory knows of this application (2026-09-28, zero domain in the harness): the library graph a candidate starts from and is compared with, the saved twin kept for comparison, where a generated node is wired into that graph, who is told of every candidate, what a flat first slope is, and which node types frame a document rather than make its physics. Its words are words.json, its prompt prompt.md, the schema of an evaluation evaluate.schema.json.
